The '''Shattered Pipeworks''' was the name given to part of the [[Tularan Marsh]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. The name came from the numerous massive broken pipes in the area.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Shattered Pipeworks appears on Taris in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
